nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the family piggy bank name.
Public mapping (address => uint) storing each saver's credited balance.
Public uint initialized to address(this).balance representing total Ether held.
Payable constructor(string _name, address _sparer) that sets the name and credits an initial balance.
Public payable function that overwrites guthaben[msg.sender] with msg.value.
Public function that checks, subtracts and transfers _betrag of Ether to msg.sender.
View getter returning the stored balance of a given sparer address.
Pure helper function returning the sum of two supplied uint values.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address used for balance indexing and Ether transfer.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction guthaben[msg.sender] - _betrag (Solidity 0.4.24, overflow/underflow possible in principle).
External Ether transfer msg.sender.transfer(_betrag), an untrusted external call that can trigger a callback.
Unchecked arithmetic addition _menge1 + _menge2 allowing integer overflow.
Constructor parameter _sparer (address) used to pick the initial balance beneficiary.
Parameter _betrag (uint) of abbuchen, the amount to subtract and transfer.
Parameter _sparer (address) of guthabenAnzeigen used to index the guthaben mapping.
Local variable startGuthaben in the constructor holding msg.value.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _name flows into the constructor body where it is stored.
Constructor parameter _sparer selects whose balance is credited, an externally supplied beneficiary.
Constructor assigns _name to the spardosenName state variable.
Constructor writes the guthaben mapping for the chosen beneficiary.
Local startGuthaben derived from msg.value is credited into the guthaben mapping.
msg.sender is used as the fallback beneficiary index when _sparer is the zero address.
msg.sender indexes the guthaben mapping that einzahlen overwrites.
einzahlen writes msg.value into guthaben[msg.sender].
msg.sender determines the balance checked and debited in abbuchen.
abbuchen's require check reads guthaben[msg.sender] and gates execution.
Parameter _betrag drives the require check and the withdrawal amount of abbuchen.
abbuchen performs guthaben[msg.sender] - _betrag with unchecked 0.4.24 arithmetic.
External parameter _betrag is the subtrahend in the unchecked balance subtraction.
The guthaben mapping value is the minuend in the unchecked subtraction.
abbuchen executes the external Ether transfer to the caller, the state-changing external interaction.
The transfer recipient is msg.sender, an attacker-controlled address that can execute code.
Parameter _betrag is the value forwarded by the transfer.
The external call to msg.sender can re-enter abbuchen before balance bookkeeping is finalized.
Parameter _sparer is used to index the guthaben mapping in guthabenAnzeigen.
guthabenAnzeigen reads the guthaben mapping value for the supplied address.
Parameter _menge1 is consumed by addieren.
Parameter _menge2 is consumed by addieren.
addieren computes _menge1 + _menge2 with no overflow protection.
External parameter _menge1 is an addend in the unchecked addition.
External parameter _menge2 is an addend in the unchecked addition.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor string parameter only exists to be stored in spardosenName and has no standalone security semantics.
Beneficiary address parameter is only meaningful inside the constructor's balance credit logic.
Withdrawal amount parameter only has meaning within abbuchen's check, subtraction and transfer flow.
Read-only lookup key parameter is fully absorbed by the getter function it parameterizes.
First addend only exists to feed the pure addition helper.
Second addend only exists to feed the pure addition helper.
Local msg.value snapshot is immediately consumed by the constructor's guthaben assignment.
